verdict.rationale: Saving and sharing filtered views is a fair question for a work-management product like monday.com, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never documents saving a filtered view or sharing one by link. The only related item (monday-docs-3) describes developers building custom board-view apps, which is a developer building block, not the saved-view capability itself.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can save a filtered view of work and share it with a link
